attempted_claim: For R in |O_{P^1×P^2}(2,2)| and rational c in (1/2,1), determine the full wall-and-chamber structure of the K-moduli spaces of klt log Fano pairs (P^1×P^2,cR): prove or disprove finiteness of the wall set; at each wall classify all K-polystable replacements, including singular torus-equivariant limits, and describe the wall-crossing morphisms; decide in particular whether these morphisms are exactly the modifications induced by VGIT wall crossing for the discriminant plane-quartic map.
decisive_failure: Volume collapse to zero at c=1 defeats uniform boundedness arguments; exact destabilizer valuations and singular smoothable replacements were never classified; point-blowup estimates are crude upper bounds rather than genuine instability results; methods used are standard toric and discrepancy techniques with no new theorem established.
